The plate looks like a square dinner plate, about 26 cm across in the image (roughly 460 px wide). The bread slice is about 230 px wide, so roughly 13 cm, and about 200 px tall, so roughly 11-12 cm. That makes a slice of sourdough about 12 × 11 cm and 1.5 cm thick. Its volume is about 12 × 11 × 1.5 × 0.85 (to account for the rounded shape), or about 170 cm³. The crumb is airy and the density is about 0.25 g/cm³, which gives roughly 45 g. A slice that size would normally weigh 45-55 g, so I'll use 50 g.
